Garments: Cream oversized wrap tailored coat with dramatic asymmetric glossy-black leather half-panel and one leather sleeve, cream shirt. Complete the coat hem conservatively; no invented trousers or shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: 深棕皮手套一对; 黑色柔软皮革大包; 银色项链; 银色耳饰一对. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE photorealistic complete outfit catalog composition on pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3. Input 1 is the APPROVED garment ensemble: preserve exactly its silhouette, textile, colors, layers, footwear and hosiery. Do not redesign or add clothes. Each remaining input is ONE matching accessory to add. Use every listed component once (earrings/gloves as a pair). Garments: Cream oversized wrap tailored coat with dramatic asymmetric glossy-black leather half-panel and one leather sleeve, cream shirt. Complete the coat hem conservatively; no invented trousers or shoes. Accessories: Input 2: 深棕皮手套一对; Input 3: 黑色柔软皮革大包; Input 4: 银色项链; Input 5: 银色耳饰一对. Keep the garment ensemble dominant and full length. Attach belts, ties and brooches naturally; place hats, bags, eyewear, jewelry and hand props neatly adjacent at realistic scale with clear separation, not overlapping important garment details. Where clothing is shown in flat lay, keep the coordinated flat lay; empty hosiery must stay separately laid flat. No person, skin, face, head, hands, legs, feet, anatomy, visible mannequin, stand or hanger. Transparent cloth reveals WHITE, never skin. Shoes and sleeves empty. No extra hats, bags, glasses, belts, jewelry or footwear beyond the input assets. No duplicates, no panels or inset images, no text/watermarks. Fully uncropped with white margins. This is an object-only wardrobe asset.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
